name: A down counter: load 4, then count down to empty

tags.name: Take
tags.comment: a push button: each press takes one off (CD)

tags.name: Load
tags.comment: a push button: puts PV, 4, into the count (LD)

tags.name: Empty
tags.comment: a lamp: on while the count is 0 or less (Q)

rungs.comment: Load puts 4 in C1.CV. Each time Take turns on, CV goes down by 1.
Empty lights while C1.CV is 0 or less.
